talkshows.title: TVRI Talk Show: Arsitektur Virtual Machine & Cloud Virtualization
talkshows.description: Siaran langsung TVRI Sumsel segmen Teknologi Informasi bersama Dr. Zaid Amin membahas konsep arsitektur virtual machine, efisiensi komputasi server, dan fondasi awal teknologi cloud virtualization.

talkshows.title: TVRI Talk Show: Virtual LAN (VLAN) & Performa Jaringan Enterprise
talkshows.description: Pembahasan interaktif siaran langsung TVRI mengenai segmentasi jaringan logis (VLAN), manajemen broadcast domain, serta rekayasa performa jaringan komputer skala enterprise.

talkshows.title: TVRI Talk Show: Dinamika Routing Jaringan & Sistem Otonomus (AS)
talkshows.description: Eksplorasi mendalam protokol dynamic routing (OSPF, BGP), tabel routing hierarkis, dan mekanisme pengalihan paket data cerdas pada backbone infrastruktur internet.

talkshows.title: TVRI Talk Show: Desain Topologi Jaringan & Infrastruktur Tangguh
talkshows.description: Kupas tuntas metodologi perencanaan topologi fisik dan logis jaringan komputer, redundansi jalur data, dan strategi mitigasi single point of failure (SPOF).

talkshows.title: TVRI Talk Show: Arsitektur Jaringan Berkecepatan Tinggi untuk Big Data
talkshows.description: Dialog siaran langsung mengenai tantangan transmisi volume data masif (Big Data), throughput tinggi, latensi rendah, dan rancang bangun jaringan data center modern.

talkshows.title: TVRI Talk Show: Simulasi dan Pemodelan Kinerja Jaringan Komputer
talkshows.description: Panduan praktis dan konseptual simulasi jaringan menggunakan simulator event-driven (Cisco Packet Tracer / NS2/NS3) sebelum implementasi skala penuh di industri.

talkshows.title: TVRI Talk Show: Jaringan Masa Depan & Konektivitas di Era Big Data
talkshows.description: Visi masa depan arsitektur konektivitas global, Software-Defined Networking (SDN), komputasi terdistribusi, dan ekosistem internet cerdas di era Big Data.

keynotes.title: Multimodal AI Architectures & Human-Trusted Cybernetic Systems
keynotes.event: International Conference on Emerging Horizons in Mathematics & Computation (MatCom–2026)
keynotes.venue: School of Sciences, Woxsen University, Hyderabad, India
keynotes.abstract: Delivering international plenary keynote on multimodal foundation models, civic compliance modeling, and human-trusted cybernetic architectures.

keynotes.title: Persuasive Computing & Cognitive Attention in Algorithmic Governance
keynotes.event: Research Mobility Program: Trustworthy AI for Behaviour Change
keynotes.venue: Institute of Visual Informatics (IVI), Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia (UKM)
keynotes.abstract: Specialized international research training on cognitive attention modeling, epistemic interface nudges, and trustworthy algorithmic oversight.

keynotes.title: The Proxy Trap in Agentic AI: Why Metric Optimization Fails Human Values
keynotes.event: International Symposium on Trustworthy AI and Autonomous Systems
keynotes.abstract: Discourse demonstrating why proxy metric optimization diverges from normative human values in autonomous decision-making agents.

keynotes.title: Sociotechnical Digital Preservation & 3D Heritage Systems
keynotes.event: Interdisciplinary Seminar: Cultural Heritage & Digital Technology
keynotes.venue: Institute of Visual Informatics (IVI), Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia (UKM)
keynotes.abstract: Demonstrating interactive 3D virtual reality reconstructions, digital heritage curation, and the maritime Srivijayapedia initiative.

keynotes.title: AI & Creativity: Human-Technology Collaboration & Ethical Guardrails
keynotes.event: National Academic Seminar on Emerging Informatics
keynotes.abstract: Investigating collaborative dynamics between generative AI models and human creative agency, proposing normative ethical guardrails.

keynotes.title: Humane Interface Design: Rewiring User Attention Against Algorithmic Distraction
keynotes.abstract: Plenary address on epistemic attention design, cybernetic feedback loops, and empirical interface nudges against automated viral algorithmic distortion.

opinions.title: Das Sein, Das Sollen: Bridging What Is and What Ought to Be in AI
opinions.abstract: The Humean is-ought problem in autonomous AI: why observing descriptive training data ('Das Sein') can never automatically yield normative ethical governance ('Das Sollen').

opinions.title: When Metrics Cannibalize Wisdom: The Proxy Trap in Academic Systems
opinions.abstract: How Goodhart's law and relentless proxy metric optimization systematically corrupt peer review, academic tenure incentives, and automated platform governance.

opinions.title: The Architecture of Intentionality: Beyond Attention Extraction
opinions.abstract: Moving beyond the extractive algorithmic engagement economy to cultivate cognitive sovereignty and epistemic hygiene against gamified interface capture.

opinions.title: The Illusions of Multimodal Ubiquity: Machine Perception vs Experience
opinions.abstract: Deconstructing the ontological gap between computational sensor fusion and phenomenological human consciousness in ambient intelligence.

opinions.title: Digital Hegemony & the Epistemic Commonweal: Reclaiming the Commons
opinions.abstract: On corporate platform enclosures, digital sovereignty, and the imperative of safeguarding open academic knowledge commons against private capture.

opinions.title: Algorithmic Serfdom vs. Autonomous Human Dignity: A 2030s Manifesto
opinions.abstract: An HCI manifesto for the 2030s: engineering cybernetic architectures that enhance human agency rather than subjecting minds to behavioral conditioning.
